title: Payton v. New York (1980)
key_points: Holding: Absent exigent circumstances or consent, police need an arrest warrant to enter a suspect's home to make a routine felony arrest.
officer_notes: Scenario: You have probable cause for an assault arrest and the suspect is home. You knock, he won't come out.
Takeaway: Get a warrant unless consent or a true exigency exists.
